# DigiPlus AI

> DigiPlus AI is a SaaS platform that gives any business its own AI sales assistant. The owner teaches the assistant their services, prices and rules in a few minutes; the assistant then answers clients 24/7 on a website chat, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger and Instagram, and hands back a written summary and a deal-likelihood score for every conversation. It is built in Tunisia and speaks Tunisian Derja and Arabizi as well as French, Arabic and English.

Website: https://digiplus.lol · Français: https://digiplus.lol/ · English: https://digiplus.lol/en

## What it does

- Answers every client message in seconds, 24 hours a day, in the language and alphabet the client writes in (Tunisian Derja in Arabic letters or Arabizi/Latin letters, French, Arabic, English).
- Uses only the services, prices, FAQ and rules the business owner wrote. It never invents a price, a discount, a deadline or a guarantee; when it does not know, it says the team will follow up and shares the owner's contact details.
- Writes an AI summary of every conversation: the client's needs, budget, objections, deal likelihood as a percentage, next steps, and a ready-to-send follow-up message.
- Lets a human take over any conversation at any moment, pausing the AI for that client only.
- Runs several assistants, one per business or per branch, each with its own knowledge, public chat link and conversations.

## Who it is for

Shops, salons, clinics, restaurants, coffee shops, real-estate agencies, online stores, agencies, trainers, and any business that receives client messages and loses sales by answering late.

## Channels

Website chat (a public chat link plus an embeddable widget), Facebook Messenger, Instagram direct messages, and WhatsApp.

## Pricing

Prices are per month. Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial, no bank card required. Payment in Tunisian dinars by D17 or bank transfer, or by card in USD.

- Free trial — 7 days, 1 assistant, 300 AI replies, 30,000 characters of business data, website chat + Messenger + Instagram.
- Starter — 39 TND or 15 USD per month. 1 assistant, 2,000 AI replies per month, 30,000 characters of business data, website chat + Messenger + Instagram.
- Pro — 99 TND or 35 USD per month. 3 assistants, 5,000 AI replies per month, 100,000 characters of business data, all channels including WhatsApp, no DigiPlus AI branding.
- Business — 199 TND or 69 USD per month. 10 assistants, 15,000 AI replies per month, 300,000 characters of business data, all channels including WhatsApp, no DigiPlus AI branding.
- Add-ons — extra assistant 19 TND or 7 USD per month; 1,000 extra AI replies 15 TND or 5 USD.

An "AI reply" is one answer sent to a client. A typical sales conversation uses 5 to 10 replies. Summaries do not count against the allowance.

## How it works

1. Create an account and name your assistant (free trial, no card).
2. Write your services, prices, FAQ and rules, then chat with the assistant yourself until the answers are right.
3. Share the chat link, add the widget to your website, or connect WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram. Read the summaries and follow up with the clients most likely to buy.

## Company

DigiPlus is based in Sfax, Tunisia, and works online with businesses across Tunisia and abroad.
